partial_invalidation.notes: When only part of the mission is invalidated, preserve valid work and retarget the rest.

vague_redirect.notes: Vague steering often benefits from safe interpretation before asking for clarification.

hard_priority_shift.notes: Large priority changes often benefit from resequencing while preserving useful completed work.

style_or_output_correction.notes: Style corrections should usually change output form without discarding valid substance.

operator_stop_and_reframe.notes: Some strong reframes justify resetting only the invalid parts, not the full mission history.
